title: First OTR Mask Collision in the 128-Bit Field
summary: Exhaustive search proves collision-freedom below index two to the forty-fifth; locate the first OTR mask collision before two to the sixty-fourth or extend the proof.

formal_statement.body: For $P(X)=X^{128}+X^7+X^2+X+1$, determine the first OTR mask collision in $[2^{45},2^{64})$, or prove collision-freedom over a larger interval.

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of OTR tweak-mask collisions in the standard 128-bit field representation.
parameters: P(X) = X^128 + X^7 + X^2 + X + 1: the polynomial fixing the 128-bit field representation
Index interval [2^45, 2^64): the unresolved range for the first mask collision
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the first OTR mask collision in the interval from 2^45 inclusive to 2^64 exclusive, or prove collision-freedom over a larger interval.

citations.label: Trick or Tweak: On the (In)security of OTR's Tweaks

progress.summary: The source reports an exhaustive search proving no tweak-polynomial collision below index 2^45 and leaves the gap to 2^64 without a formal argument. Smaller-field experiments suggest, but do not prove, a collision shortly before the birthday bound.
citation_labels: Raphael Bost et al., Trick or Tweak: On the (In)security of OTR's Tweaks
